meaning_en: To explain the reason for something.
example_en: This factor accounts for the observed changes.
examples_extra: How do you account for the missing money?
This accounts for his bad mood.

meaning_en: To publicly support a particular cause or policy.
example_en: She advocates for stronger environmental protection laws.
examples_extra: She advocates free education for all.
They advocate much stricter laws.

meaning_en: To hint at or refer to indirectly.
example_en: The author often alludes to classical mythology.
examples_extra: She alluded to future changes.
He alluded to the problem briefly.
note_fa: به‌طور غیرمستقیم اشاره کردن؛ allude to.

meaning_en: Open to more than one interpretation; unclear.
example_en: The survey results were ambiguous.
examples_extra: His answer was deliberately ambiguous.
The law is ambiguous on this point.

meaning_en: A pair of punctuation marks, < >, used in computing.
example_en: Use angle brackets to enclose optional parameters in code.
examples_extra: Use angle brackets in the code.
The tag is inside angle brackets.

meaning_en: To add something to the end of a document.
example_en: Please append the data tables to the main report.
examples_extra: Append your signature at the end.
The list was appended to the report.

meaning_en: Based on random choice or personal whim, not reason.
example_en: The committee made an arbitrary decision without consulting anyone.
examples_extra: The choice seemed completely arbitrary.
The rules are arbitrary and unfair.

meaning_en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
example_en: The study asserts a strong correlation between diet and health.
examples_extra: He firmly asserted his innocence.
She asserts that she is right.

meaning_en: A star-shaped symbol (*) used to indicate a note.
example_en: An asterisk denotes a footnote in academic texts.
examples_extra: Put an asterisk next to your name.
The asterisk marks a footnote.

meaning_en: Able to be trusted as being accurate or true.
example_en: This book is an authoritative source on ancient history.
examples_extra: This is the most authoritative book on the subject.
She spoke in an authoritative tone.

meaning_en: To reluctantly reach a decision or belief.
example_en: Given the evidence, we are forced to conclude he is guilty.
examples_extra: We may be forced to conclude he was lying.
I seem to be forced to conclude it was a mistake.

meaning_en: Outside the range or limits of something.
example_en: That question is beyond the scope of this discussion.
examples_extra: That topic is beyond the scope of this book.
The question went beyond the scope of the meeting.
note_fa: خارج از حیطه و محدوده چیزی.

meaning_en: Large, uppercase letters, often used for clarity.
example_en: Please write your name and address in block capitals.
examples_extra: Please write your name in block capitals.
The sign was printed in block capitals.

meaning_en: Printed in thick, dark letters.
example_en: Important terms are often written in bold text.
examples_extra: She made a bold decision to quit.
The headings are printed in bold type.

meaning_en: A pair of marks ( ) or [ ] used in writing.
example_en: Please put the optional information in brackets.
examples_extra: Put the extra details in brackets.
She is in the highest tax bracket.

meaning_en: A small symbol used to list items.
example_en: Please summarize your key arguments using bullet points.
examples_extra: Use bullet points in your CV.
She listed ideas as bullet points.
note_fa: نقطه گلوله‌ای در فهرست؛ bullet list.

meaning_en: Uppercase letters used for emphasis or proper nouns.
example_en: Always start a sentence with a capital letter.
examples_extra: Write your name in capitals.
The form asks for block capitals.
note_fa: حروف بزرگ؛ in capitals یعنی با حروف درشت.

meaning_en: To place items into specific groups based on shared characteristics.
example_en: We need to categorise the data before analysis.
examples_extra: They categorised the books by topic.
She categorises all expenses very carefully.

meaning_en: Curly brackets {} used in mathematics or programming.
example_en: Use chain brackets to denote a set of elements.
examples_extra: Use chain brackets in the code.
The formula uses chain brackets.

meaning_en: The title at the beginning of a chapter.
example_en: Ensure each chapter heading is clear and concise.
examples_extra: Read the chapter heading first.
The long chapter heading is interesting.

meaning_en: To refer to a source as evidence or authority.
example_en: Students must cite all sources used in their research papers.
examples_extra: She cited three reliable sources.
He cited the law in court.

meaning_en: Logical and consistent; easy to understand.
example_en: Her argument was well-structured and coherent.
examples_extra: She gave a surprisingly clear and coherent answer.
His very long essay lacks any coherent argument.

meaning_en: To add to something in a way that improves it.
example_en: The new data perfectly complements the existing research.
examples_extra: A good red wine complements the meal perfectly.
Her creative skills complement his experience well.

meaning_en: To consist of or be made up of.
example_en: The committee comprises ten members from various departments.
examples_extra: The new advisory committee comprises exactly twelve members.
The United Kingdom comprises four separate historic nations.

meaning_en: To be made up or composed of.
example_en: The team consists of five researchers and two assistants.
examples_extra: The team consists of eleven players.
Her diet consists mainly of vegetables.
note_fa: همیشه با of می‌آید: consist of؛ به‌صورت مجهول به‌کار نمی‌رود.

meaning_en: To deny the truth of a statement.
example_en: His testimony seemed to contradict earlier statements.
examples_extra: The two witnesses contradict each other.
Don't contradict your boss in public.
note_fa: نقض کردن حرف کسی؛ اسمش contradiction است.

meaning_en: Opposite or reverse.
example_en: The converse is also true in this situation.
examples_extra: The converse is also true.
They hold converse opinions on the matter.
note_fa: به‌عنوان صفت یعنی «معکوس»؛ با converse فعل (گفتگو کردن) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To duplicate text or data from one place to another.
example_en: Students should avoid simply copying and pasting from sources.
examples_extra: Just copy and paste the address into the form.
Students should not copy and paste essays from the internet.
note_fa: در کامپیوتر: کپی و پیست؛ با cut and paste فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To write something again exactly as it is.
example_en: She had to copy out the entire essay by hand.
examples_extra: I'll copy out the hotel information for you.
She will copy out the poem in her notebook.

meaning_en: Extremely important or essential for success.
example_en: Data analysis is crucial for drawing valid conclusions.
examples_extra: Removing debt was crucial for the economy.
It is crucial to check the facts first.
note_fa: حیاتی؛ با it is crucial to شروع جمله رایج است.

meaning_en: { } symbols used in writing, especially in programming.
example_en: Use curly brackets to define sets in mathematics.
examples_extra: Use curly brackets in the code here.
The set is written in curly brackets.

meaning_en: To move text or images from one place to another.
example_en: He used cut and paste to rearrange paragraphs in his essay.
examples_extra: I usually cut and paste notes into my essay.
Cut and paste the paragraph to the end.
note_fa: برش و چسباندن متن؛ با copy and paste فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To reach a conclusion by reasoning from evidence.
example_en: From the data, we can deduce a clear trend.
examples_extra: We quickly deduced the correct answer together.
She cleverly deduced his secret motive yesterday.

meaning_en: To clearly show the existence or truth of something.
example_en: The experiment will demonstrate the principles of physics.
examples_extra: She clearly demonstrated the new technique today.
Thousands demonstrated peacefully downtown yesterday.

meaning_en: To be a sign of; to indicate or mean.
example_en: The symbol 'x' often denotes an unknown variable.
examples_extra: The red symbol denotes grave danger here.
Square brackets denote optional grammar items here.

meaning_en: Angled brackets used in mathematics or computing, e.g., < >.
example_en: Use diamond brackets to denote generic types in programming.
examples_extra: Please use diamond brackets in the code here.
Diamond brackets clarify Java generics well.

meaning_en: To twist or misrepresent facts or meaning.
meaning_fa: تحریف کردن، کج و معوج کردن
example_en: The media can sometimes distort public perception of events.
examples_extra: The biased report seriously distorted the basic facts.
Misleading statistics can distort the whole picture easily.
note_fa: تحریف کردن؛ کتاب: distort the picture.

meaning_en: To draw aimlessly while thinking or bored.
example_en: He often doodles in his notebook during long lectures.
examples_extra: He doodled idly in the margins of notes.
She always doodles flowers while on the phone.

meaning_en: To increase something to twice its original size or amount.
example_en: The research team plans to double their efforts.
examples_extra: They suddenly doubled the ticket price again.
Our company sales doubled again last year.

meaning_en: (n) A preliminary version; (v) to prepare a preliminary version.
example_en: Please draft the introduction for the report by tomorrow.
examples_extra: She quickly wrote a rough first draft yesterday.
He carefully drafted the formal letter himself.

meaning_en: To accept or adopt an idea or theory enthusiastically.
example_en: The research paper embraces a new theoretical framework.
examples_extra: They embraced each other warmly once again.
We should embrace positive change together now.

meaning_en: Based on observation or experience, not just theory.
example_en: The study provides strong empirical evidence for the hypothesis.
examples_extra: His claims lack any empirical evidence.
The theory is based on empirical research.
note_fa: تجربی؛ مبتنی بر مشاهده نه صرف نظریه.

meaning_en: To be a perfect example of something.
example_en: Her dedication epitomises the spirit of the team.
examples_extra: She epitomises the modern working mother.
The film epitomises 1990s youth culture.
note_fa: مظهر بودن؛ نمونه کامل چیزی بودن.

meaning_en: To present and explain an idea or theory in detail.
example_en: The professor expounded on the complex philosophical concept.
examples_extra: The professor expounded his theory for an hour.
She expounded on the benefits of exercise.

meaning_en: A specific style and size of text characters.
example_en: Choose a clear, readable font for your academic paper.
examples_extra: Choose a clear font style.
The font is too small.

meaning_en: The specific height or size of text characters.
example_en: The recommended font size for headings is 14pt.
examples_extra: Increase the font size, please.
The font size is too small.

meaning_en: The way something is arranged or presented.
example_en: Ensure your essay follows the correct academic format.
examples_extra: The report follows a clear format.
Choose the right file format.

meaning_en: Arranged from smallest to largest or lowest to highest.
example_en: Please list the numbers in ascending order for clarity.
examples_extra: List the numbers in ascending order.
The names are in ascending order.

meaning_en: Arranged from largest to smallest or highest to lowest.
example_en: The results were presented in descending order of scores.
examples_extra: Sort the prices in descending order.
The list is in descending order.

meaning_en: Following a particular order or arrangement.
example_en: The steps must be followed in sequence for the experiment.
examples_extra: Do the steps in sequence.
The events happened in sequence.

meaning_en: The rate or frequency of something occurring.
example_en: The incidence of heart disease has increased recently.
examples_extra: The incidence of flu rises in winter.
They studied the incidence of the disease.

meaning_en: To start a line of text further from the margin.
example_en: Please indent the first line of each paragraph.
examples_extra: Indent the first line of each paragraph.
She indented the whole paragraph.

meaning_en: To show or point out something.
example_en: The survey results indicate a growing trend.
examples_extra: The arrow indicates the exit.
Research indicates a link between diet and health.

meaning_en: To deduce or conclude information from evidence.
example_en: From her silence, I inferred she was upset.
examples_extra: We can infer his meaning from the context.
What do you infer from this?

meaning_en: An example or single occurrence of something.
example_en: This is a clear instance of poor planning.
examples_extra: For instance, take my brother.
This is a rare instance.

meaning_en: Punctuation marks (" ") used to show direct speech or quotes.
example_en: Remember to use inverted commas for direct quotations.
examples_extra: Put the quote in inverted commas.
Use single inverted commas here.

meaning_en: To print or write words in italics.
example_en: Please italicise book titles in your bibliography.
examples_extra: Italicise the book titles in your essay.
She italicised the key words.

meaning_en: A typeface with slanted characters, used for emphasis or titles.
example_en: Use italics for foreign words in your essay.
examples_extra: The titles are printed in italics.
She wrote the quote in italics.

meaning_en: To write something quickly, usually brief notes.
example_en: I'll just jot down a few ideas for the essay.
examples_extra: Let me jot down your number.
He jotted down the address quickly.

meaning_en: Small letters of the alphabet, not capitals.
example_en: Always start sentences with an upper case, not lower case.
examples_extra: Please write your full name in lower case.
Your new password must be in lower case.

meaning_en: To write something down to remember it.
example_en: Please make a note of the key findings.
examples_extra: Let me make a note of today's date.
She made a note of his phone number.

meaning_en: Make ineffective; nullify; deny the existence of.
example_en: His poor performance negated all his previous efforts.
examples_extra: This setback negates all our previous efforts.
One careless error can negate everything else.

meaning_en: Despite something; in spite of.
example_en: Notwithstanding the rain, the event was a great success.
examples_extra: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, we went out.
He persisted bravely, notwithstanding the obvious risks.

meaning_en: To cover part of something else; to share common elements.
example_en: The two research areas significantly overlap.
examples_extra: Our holidays overlap by two days.
The two jobs overlap a lot.

meaning_en: To assume or suggest something as a fact.
example_en: Researchers posit that climate change affects migration patterns.
examples_extra: The theory posits a link between diet and health.
She posited that trade would recover soon.
note_fa: فرض کردن؛ چیزی را به‌عنوان واقعیت مطرح کردن.

meaning_en: Most common or important; having power over others.
example_en: The predominant theory suggests climate change is human-induced.
examples_extra: English is the predominant language here.
The predominant colour is deep blue.

meaning_en: An introduction at the beginning of a book or speech.
example_en: The author wrote a lengthy preface explaining his motivations.
examples_extra: She wrote a short preface to the book.
The preface explains the author’s aims.
note_fa: مقدمه؛ دیباچه آغاز کتاب یا سخنرانی.

meaning_en: Punctuation marks used to show direct speech or titles.
example_en: Always use quotation marks for direct quotes in academic writing.
examples_extra: Put the title in quotation marks.
She always uses quotation marks correctly.
note_fa: علامت نقل‌قول «»؛ در آمریکا quotation marks.

meaning_en: Short extracts from a text or speech.
example_en: The essay included several insightful quotes from the author.
examples_extra: The article includes many famous quotes.
She collects truly inspiring quotes.

meaning_en: Think deeply or carefully about something.
example_en: It's important to reflect upon your experiences for growth.
examples_extra: She reflected upon her life.
He sat reflecting upon the news.
note_fa: کتاب: reflect upon = think about؛ تأمل کردن.

meaning_en: Say something again for emphasis or clarity.
example_en: Let me reiterate the main points of our proposal.
examples_extra: She reiterated her main point.
He firmly reiterated the serious warning.

meaning_en: to live in a particular place
example_en: Many students reside in dormitories during their studies.
examples_extra: She resides in central London.
They now reside abroad happily.
note_fa: کتاب: reside = live؛ رسمی: اقامت داشتن.

meaning_en: to go or come back to a place
example_en: The analysis will return to this point in Chapter 3.
examples_extra: He finally returned home late at night.
Please return the library book by Friday.

meaning_en: punctuation marks ( ) used for extra information
example_en: Use round brackets for parenthetical remarks in academic texts.
examples_extra: Put your name in round brackets after the title.
Round brackets are used for extra information in text.

meaning_en: to produce copies of a document
example_en: Please run off 20 copies of this handout.
examples_extra: Can you run off fifty copies of this report?
She will run off the leaflets this afternoon.

meaning_en: To write or draw carelessly and quickly.
example_en: He scribbled a few notes during the lecture.
examples_extra: She scribbled a quick note and left it on the table.
He scribbled the address on the back of a receipt.

meaning_en: A box with a colored background used to highlight text.
example_en: Key definitions are presented in a shaded box.
examples_extra: Key terms appear in a shaded box.
Read the shaded box first.

meaning_en: Lowercase letters, not capital letters.
example_en: Please write your name in small letters.
examples_extra: Write your name in small letters.
Use small letters, not capitals.

meaning_en: To a moderate extent or degree.
example_en: The results were somewhat unexpected, but still valid.
examples_extra: She felt somewhat tired after work.
The results were somewhat surprising to us.

meaning_en: Punctuation marks [ ] used for specific purposes.
example_en: Use square brackets to add editorial comments.
examples_extra: Put the note in square brackets.
Use square brackets for the comment.

meaning_en: A heading given to a subsection of a document.
example_en: Each chapter had several clear sub-headings.
examples_extra: Each chapter has several sub-headings.
Add a sub-heading to each section.

meaning_en: To include or place within a larger category.
example_en: These smaller issues are subsumed under a broader topic.
examples_extra: The new rules subsume the old ones.
Smaller firms were subsumed into the group.

meaning_en: An additional, explanatory title for a book or article.
example_en: The book's subtitle clarified its specific focus.
examples_extra: The film has English subtitles.
Read the subtitle at the bottom.

meaning_en: To give a brief statement of the main points.
example_en: Please summarise the key findings of the report.
examples_extra: Can you summarise the report briefly?
She summarised the main points.

meaning_en: A character written above the line, like in footnotes.
example_en: Use a superscript for footnote references.
examples_extra: The footnote marker is in superscript.
Write the number in superscript.

meaning_en: By that means; as a result of that.
example_en: He ignored the warning, thereby causing the accident.
examples_extra: He left early, thereby missing the speech.
She saved money, thereby buying a car.

meaning_en: The name of a book, article, or academic work.
example_en: The title of her thesis was "Quantum Entanglement."
examples_extra: What's the title of the book?
She won the world title.

meaning_en: Mention or deal with a subject briefly.
example_en: The report only briefly touched upon the economic impact.
examples_extra: He touched upon the problem.
She only touched upon the issue.

meaning_en: Type without looking at the keyboard.
example_en: Learning to touch-type significantly improved my productivity.
examples_extra: She can touch-type really fast.
Try to learn to touch-type properly.

meaning_en: Cause an event or reaction to happen.
example_en: The news report triggered a strong public reaction.
examples_extra: The shocking news triggered protests across the city.
Smoking can trigger a severe asthma attack.

meaning_en: A particular design of letters and numbers.
example_en: Choose a clear typeface for your academic paper.
examples_extra: Choose a clear typeface for your CV.
The typeface on the poster is too small.

meaning_en: An original written or typed text before printing.
example_en: The author submitted the final typescript to the publisher.
examples_extra: She sent the typescript to her agent.
The typescript still needs careful proofreading.
note_fa: یعنی «متن تایپ‌شدهٔ نویسنده» قبل از چاپ.

meaning_en: To emphasize or highlight something.
example_en: The report underscores the need for urgent action.
examples_extra: This underscores the need for reform.
The report underscores key findings.

meaning_en: Capital letters.
example_en: Please write your name in upper case.
examples_extra: Write your name in upper case.
UPPER CASE means capital letters.

meaning_en: By which; by means of which.
meaning_fa: که به موجب آن، به وسیله آن
example_en: They developed a system whereby students can learn online.
examples_extra: They signed a deal whereby everyone benefits.
It's a system whereby votes decide.

meaning_en: Existing or happening over a large area or among many people.
example_en: The internet has led to widespread access to information.
examples_extra: The disease is now widespread.
There is widespread public support.
